Section C (Bash-cd into a nested repo with an allow-all guard): rc=0. Sections F and G (git erroring or absent): rc=2 'write guard missing', so the old hook failed closed there.

checks_run.procedure: Static review at 85a0efa. CI workflow: permissions, fetch-depth, pinned actions, failure propagation. Credential-pattern scan of the tracked files. Frontmatter of the ten agents, with their tools and a hook command pointing at MTH_GUARD_ROOT that fails closed. Per-role settings: matcher covers Write|Edit|NotebookEdit|MultiEdit.
checks_run.command: cat -n .github/workflows/delivery-gates.yml; git grep -I -n -E '<credential regex>' -- . ':!docs/delivery/runs' ':!trading_agent'; per-file frontmatter and settings inspection
checks_run.expected: contents: read; fetch-depth 0; SHA-pinned actions; plain run steps (non-zero fails the job); no credentials; ten consistent hook configurations
checks_run.actual: CI: permissions contents: read; fetch-depth 0; actions pinned by commit SHA; run steps propagate failures. The secret scan matched only the regex text in my own earlier evidence logs, not real credentials. No .env or key files are tracked. All 10 agents use the $MTH_GUARD_ROOT guard with the fail-closed prefix, and all 10 settings files use the full matcher. Unchanged residual: CI does not run '--stage DGx' for an approved gate beyond --pipeline, which by design re-verifies approved gates historically.

checks_run.procedure: Review of the source diff cbc755d..85a0efa across tools/, .claude/, agents.md and decisions.md: guard-write.mjs (MTH_GUARD_ROOT, guardedRoots, deepest-root selection), run-agent.sh (export), the 10 settings and 10 frontmatter hook commands, rules.mjs (fileURLToPath), and the tests
checks_run.command: git diff cbc755d..85a0efa -- tools/ .claude/ docs/delivery/agents.md docs/delivery/decisions.md; cat -n tools/agents/guard-write.mjs tools/agents/run-agent.sh
checks_run.expected: the changes fix F-DG0-134 and F-DG0-224 without new gaps
checks_run.actual: The deepest-root logic and symlink real-path re-check are correct, and the rules.mjs path decoding is correct. The agent's shell can't change MTH_GUARD_ROOT. Gaps: the git-error catch in guardedRoots() fails open (F-DG0-135). The runner doesn't isolate user-level settings, which the guard treats as scratch (F-DG0-136); this is pre-existing, and it is not addressed by D-020/D-023 disclosures. No test covers the git-failure path.

summary: FAIL. F-DG0-134 is CLOSED_VERIFIED: the hook no longer picks its guard from its cwd, and main-repo and worktree protected paths are blocked from a worktree and after a Bash cd, both differentially and live. Two new Medium, mandatory findings remain. F-DG0-135: the fix fails open. If git errors or is missing, worktrees drop out of the guarded roots, and an agent can trigger that with one allowed Write to ~/.gitconfig; the old hook failed closed. F-DG0-136: the runner loads user-level Claude settings, which the guard treats as scratch. A {"disableAllHooks": true} there disabled the guard in a live runner probe, and a protected write succeeded. The git-status control can't see the change. Tests (56/56 and 5/5), prefreeze in a fresh clone, candidate identity, validator modes, CI and the secrets scan all pass.
